title: Georgia Statewide Ballot Measures
description: Curated statewide ballot measures (constitutional amendments and statewide referenda) for Georgia. One file spans multiple election cycles; consumers select measures by electionDate. Measures are never deleted after an election -- they are retained as a historical record and their outcome is captured via the terminal `passed`/`failed` status and the `results` object.

generatedAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO timestamp the file was last curated.

election.description: Human-readable name of the focal election, e.g. 'November 3, 2026 General Election'. When the file spans multiple elections this describes the current/upcoming one.

electionDate.description: Default election date (YYYY-MM-DD) applied to any measure that omits its own electionDate.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the file targets.

certifiedCount.description: Optional convenience count of certified measures for the focal election.

potentialCount.description: Optional convenience count of potential measures for the focal election.

status.description: Lifecycle stage. 'potential' = passed the General Assembly but not yet certified for the ballot. 'certified' = certified by the Secretary of State and on the ballot. 'passed'/'failed' = terminal outcome recorded after the election is certified; these serve as the authoritative pass/fail tag and drive the 'Ballot measure passed/failed' label in the UI.

title.description: Full descriptive title of the measure.

summary.description: Plain-language summary of what the measure does.

statusNote.description: Optional note about the measure's current lifecycle position (e.g. what still has to happen for a 'potential' measure to reach the ballot).

electionDate.description: Election date (YYYY-MM-DD) this measure appears on. Falls back to metadata.electionDate when absent. Consumers use this to select the focal election and to archive past-cycle measures from active display without deleting them.

identifier.description: Bill/resolution number that referred the measure to the ballot.

url.description: Link to the enabling legislation on legis.ga.gov.

enablingLegislation.description: The General Assembly bill/resolution that placed the measure on the ballot.

fullText.description: URL to the full amendment/referendum text, or null if unavailable.

noPercent.description: Percent voting no. If omitted, consumers derive it as 100 - yesPercent.

passed.description: Whether the measure was approved by voters. Should agree with the terminal `status` (passed/failed).

totalVotes.description: Total votes cast on the measure, if reported.

results.description: Certified vote outcome. Null until results are certified after the election.

allOf.$comment: A terminal status must carry a results object, and a results object implies a terminal status -- the two must not disagree.
